resources.string: ShelfOS Phase 4B manual UAT (debug build only)

Checklist (use the synthetic book only):
1. Long-press a word: the selection toolbar should show Highlight, Add note and Copy (only when the capability above says OFFERED).
2. Highlight a phrase, then Add note on another; both should draw (filled vs underlined).
3. Tap a drawn mark: an editor opens and the reader controls do not toggle.
4. Rotate the tablet and reopen the book: marks come back.
5. Notes (reader controls) lists everything; tap a row to jump back to it.
6. With a selection active press Back once: only the selection goes away.
7. On an old WebView the toolbar must NOT offer Highlight; Notes still offers Add note at current position and bookmarks work.
